newsitem.title: JAPAN: Peru's Fujimori tells Japan 200 taken hostage.
newsitem.headline: Peru's Fujimori tells Japan 200 taken hostage.

text.p: Peruvian President Alberto Fujimori told Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto on Wednesday that 200 people were taken hostage by a guerrilla group which attacked the residence of the Japanese ambassador to Peru, a Japanese Foreign Ministry official said.
Fujimori told Hashimoto on the telephone that Interior Minister Juan Briones Davila was negotiating with the guerrillas to seek the release of the hostages, the Foreign Ministry official said.
Hashimoto asked Fujimori to give the highest priority to the hostages' security, the official said.
Fujimori confirmed that the Peruvian foreign and agriculture ministers were among those taken hostage.
The Japanese Foreign Ministry was also in contact with the U.S. State Department and the British Foreign Ministry over the affair, the official said. He did not elaborate.
